title: ID0423784-DC/Si-D/FI-[Y2 / R4 313038805001]-Kotka converter E17 and router2 ECONNREFUSED 10.20.17.2:8118
description:
Reported behavior/issue
: Router2 ECONNREFUSED 10.20.17.2:8118 numerous times  and converter giving E17 error numerous times 1 week backward.
Solution
:
Action
: RF-FI will continue by checking ethernet and power supply cable wirings and if ok, then router2 replacement. Same applies to converter.
